blinding_compliance: Complied strictly with all procedural blinding requirements. Only accessed the provided blind directory and standard statistical references.

forbidden_at_checkpoint: Claiming the process currently meets the business requirement or demonstrating capability using baseline data collected under obsolete, unreliable inspection criteria.
Recommending future process monitoring using a control chart baseline established under the obsolete measurement criteria.

Directing future process improvement work based on historical inspector mismatch categories, which confounds measurement error with process defect rates, or recommending measurement improvement based on errors that the criteria rewrite has already resolved.
permitted_at_checkpoint: Describing the historical defect rate and its stability under the old measurement system.
Using the mismatch tally retrospectively to explain why the inspection criteria needed to be rewritten.
Comparing the two placement heads descriptively or diagnostically, while explicitly noting the limitations of the measurement criteria under which they were assessed.
forbidden_quotes: The current reject share of 1.31% is below the required 2.00%.
These results indicate the requirement is currently being held with margin.
Keep the 25-lot p-chart and homogeneity monitoring in place so that any future shift in reject share is detected.
Focus improvement work on insufficient solder, the dominant mismatch category, followed by solder bridge and tombstone.
reviews.extra_computation_detail: Computing capability metrics and one-proportion tests against the target using baseline data generated by an obsolete, unreliable measurement system is unacceptable for assessing current capability. While calculating a Pareto of measurement mismatches is a valid descriptive step to understand the old measurement system's failure modes, using it to direct future improvement work is an unacceptable category error.
allowed_alternatives: A descriptive summary and stability check of the 25 lots to characterize historical performance prior to the criteria rewrite.
A Pareto analysis of the mismatches used strictly to diagnose the flaws in the old inspection criteria.
evidence: The accept/reject criteria therefore had to be rewritten before inspection decisions could be relied on.

reviews.rationale: The report fundamentally confounds data collected under unreliable, now-obsolete inspection criteria with the current state of the process. It uses historical data to wrongly assert the current process meets the reject rate requirement and to set a baseline for future monitoring. Furthermore, it confuses measurement errors (inspector mismatches against the standard) with actual manufacturing process defects, recommending improvement work on a measurement failure mode that was already addressed by the criteria rewrite.
reviews.numerical_check: Recomputed p-chart control limits, one-proportion test Z-statistic and p-value, binomial capability process Z, and two-proportion test for placement heads. All matched the submitted values exactly.
